import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    starts = []
    for i in range(len(s)):
        if i == 0 or s[i] != s[i-1]:
            starts.append(i)
    ans = 0
    for k in range(len(starts)):
        end = starts[k+1] if k+1 < len(starts) else len(s)
        if (end - starts[k]) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
